notes.title: Satelum Demo "Behavior Machine" Completes First Playtest- Thanks for Wishlist !
notes.content:
Thank you for adding us to your wishlist!

On June 21st, 2025, the Behavior Machine demo of Satelum had its very first hands-on public playtest — and received enthusiastic feedback from players!Everyone who joined the demo received a Satelum-themed souvenir.We gathered over 50 wishlists during the event — a milestone that means a lot to us!While continuing development on the full version, we’ll keep polishing this demo and plan to showcase it at a future Next Fest as a playable preview.

Thank you for your trust and support from the very beginning.Stay tuned!

06/30/2025By Jia-Yi-Bing-Ping!
